morning.insight:
**한미·미중 정상회담이 몰린 한 주 — 무역·에너지·AI의 향방**

전일 시장은 **원유 급락(-4.82%)이 만든 위험선호 랠리**로 요약됩니다. 호르무즈 통항과 미·이란 대화 기대가 지정학 프리미엄을 제거하면서 눌려있던 AI·반도체 매수가 폭발했습니다(메타 +11%, Arm +15.4%, 인텔 +12%).

다만 제론의 관점에서 세 가지를 짚습니다:

1. **원유 하락은 일시적일 수 있다** — 브렌트유는 여전히 $100선, 연초 대비 WTI +66%로 에너지 인플레의 근본 해결이 아닙니다. 트럼프의 '이란 궤멸' 발언이 보여주듯 안보 리스크는 여전히 살아있어 유가 반등 시 증시 압력이 재개될 수 있습니다.
2. **한미 정상회담은 '안보·방산·에너지' 패키지** — 핵잠 연료·전작권·조선 협력과 대미투자(웨스팅하우스 지분·텍사스 가스발전·원전 8기)가 한데 묶였습니다. 이는 단순 투자가 아니라 **한미 에너지·안보 동맹의 재편**으로, 국내 원전·방산·조선 밸류체인이 구조적 수혜를 누릴 구간입니다.
3. **OECD 성장률 3.7% 상향의 함의** — G20 최대폭 상향은 수출·생산 견인을 반영하지만, 서민 체감경기와의 괴리가 정치적 논쟁(탄핵·특수본)의 배경이 되고 있습니다.

> 🎯 **오늘의 관전:** 미중 정상회담(시진핑 방미) 개막 — 무역휴전 연장 여부가 반도체·희토류·원화 환율 전반의 방향타가 됩니다.

articles.headline: OECD, 올해 韓 성장률 3.7%로 올렸다
articles.eng: OECD raises Korea's growth forecast to 3.7%
articles.body: OECD가 중간 경제전망 보고서에서 2026년 한국의 실질 경제성장률을 종전 2.6%에서 3.7%로 상향 조정했다. 성장률 전망치를 1%포인트 이상 올린 것은 이례적이다.

articles.headline: 美 금리 인상에 국채 5%…코스피, 반도체로 버티나
articles.eng: KOSPI leans on chips amid 5% Treasury yields
articles.body: 미국 연준의 기준금리 인상으로 국내 증시가 다시 금리 변수에 민감해졌다. 반도체주가 상승 흐름을 이어가면 코스피 방어력이 높아지지만 금리·환율 부담이 지속될 경우 6,700선 안팎 변동성이 확대될 수 있다.

articles.headline: 홍지선 국토장관 "주택 공급은 실행이 핵심"…부천 대장 현장 첫 행보
articles.eng: Land minister stresses housing supply execution
articles.body: 홍지선 국토교통부 장관이 취임 후 첫 현장 행보로 부천 대장 신도시 현장을 찾아 계획보다 속도감 있는 실질적 주택 공급을 강조했다.

articles.headline: 추석 연휴 전국 공공기관·학교 주차장 9,000여 곳 무료 개방
articles.eng: 9,000 public parking lots open free for Chuseok
articles.body: 귀성객 주차 편의를 위해 전국 지자체·공공기관·학교 등 9,000여 개 주차장이 추석 연휴 동안 무료로 개방된다.

articles.headline: Trump Threatens to Annihilate Iran as He Lays Out Foreign-Policy Vision at U.N.
articles.eng: Trump Threatens to Annihilate Iran at the U.N.
articles.body: President Trump labeled himself a man of peace while threatening to 'annihilate' Iran and wield American power against other nations in his address to the United Nations.

articles.headline: In Trump, Xi Sees 'Rare Window' to Convince Taiwan That Resistance Is Futile
articles.eng: Xi sees a 'rare window' on Taiwan in Trump
articles.body: Beijing is courting Taiwan's opposition and quietly helped stage its leader's landmark mainland visit to pull the island into its orbit ahead of the Xi-Trump summit.

articles.headline: Treasury Selloff Deepens, Sending 10-Year Yield Above 5.1%
articles.eng: 10-year Treasury yield tops 5.1%
articles.body: The Treasury yield jumped to its highest level since July 2007 and its biggest one-day increase in more than a year, as oil prices climbed and inflation concerns built.

articles.headline: A Rocket Supply Crunch Is Making It Harder to Hitch a Ride to Space
articles.eng: Rocket supply crunch strains space access
articles.body: There's a rush to secure flights as SpaceX winds down its flagship vehicle and rivals try to ramp up production.

articles.headline: Trump Weighs Diesel Export Ban as Fuel Prices Soar
articles.eng: Trump considers diesel export ban
articles.body: Trump said he is considering restricting diesel exports in an effort to curb soaring fuel prices, as oil rallied and inflation worries deepened.

articles.headline: Iranian Flights Halted in Several Countries as Part of U.S. Pressure Campaign
articles.eng: Iranian flights halted under US pressure
articles.body: Iranian flights are being halted in several countries as part of a U.S. pressure campaign over the Strait of Hormuz, further squeezing the Islamic Republic.

articles.headline: Stocks Fall as Inflation Jitters Boost Bond Yields: Markets Wrap
articles.eng: Stocks fall as inflation jitters boost bond yields
articles.body: Stocks joined bonds lower as a rally in oil prices stoked inflation worries. Brent crude settled around $103, fueling bets the Fed will keep hiking, and a weak 5-year note sale pushed yields toward two-decade highs.

articles.headline: US Prepares Plan for 90-Day Diesel Export Ban, Report Says
articles.eng: US readies 90-day diesel export ban plan
articles.body: The US is said to be preparing a plan for a 90-day ban on diesel exports as fuel prices climb, further roiling energy and refining markets.

articles.headline: Shell, Partners Poised to Approve Doubling of LNG Canada Project
articles.eng: Shell set to double LNG Canada project
articles.body: Shell and its partners are poised to approve a doubling of the LNG Canada project, betting on sustained global gas demand amid the energy crisis.

articles.headline: Dan Ives Joins Closed-End Fund Wave With AI-Focused Vehicle
articles.eng: Dan Ives launches AI-focused fund vehicle
articles.body: Prominent tech analyst Dan Ives is joining the closed-end fund trend with an AI-focused investment vehicle, underscoring enduring demand for AI-themed exposure.

articles.headline: Muse Sinks 'Inertia' Shares as Meta's AI Agent Reshapes Consumer Tech
articles.eng: Meta's Muse drags down 'inertia' stocks
articles.body: Meta's Muse AI agent is pressuring companies whose business models depend on consumer inertia, as the technology reshapes how users shop and interact.

articles.headline: Risky Stocks Lose Edge as Interest Rates Climb
articles.eng: Risky stocks lose edge as rates climb
articles.body: High-beta and speculative stocks are losing their performance edge as rising interest rates and elevated bond yields force investors to de-risk.

articles.headline: At the U.N., Trump Lays Out a Winner-Takes-All Vision of U.S. Power
articles.eng: Trump lays out winner-takes-all vision at U.N.
articles.body: In his U.N. speech, Trump threatened Iran while advancing a winner-takes-all vision of American power over Venezuela, Greenland and other regions.

articles.headline: Xi Seeks to Extend Truce With Trump
articles.eng: Xi seeks to extend truce with Trump
articles.body: Facing an American president constrained by war and politics, China's leader may seek to lock in a tactical truce during his Washington state visit.

articles.headline: The Former Fracking Executive Selling Trump's 'Energy Dominance' Vision
articles.eng: Ex-fracking executive sells energy dominance vision
articles.body: A former fracking executive is at the center of selling Trump's 'energy dominance' vision as the administration navigates soaring fuel prices and the Iran war.

articles.headline: Trump's Domestic Policy Law Is Starting to Bite Before the Midterms
articles.eng: Trump's domestic law bites before midterms
articles.body: The 'One Big Beautiful Bill' is starting to hit American families on affordability just weeks before the midterm elections.

articles.headline: Iran's President Speaks at the United Nations in a Rare Wartime Address
articles.eng: Iran's president speaks at U.N. in wartime address
articles.body: Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the U.N. General Assembly in a rare wartime appearance, as Tehran weighed renewed talks with Washington.

articles.headline: Trump Welcomes China's Xi Jinping to Washington for State Visit
articles.eng: Trump welcomes Xi for state visit
articles.body: Xi Jinping began his state visit to Washington, with trade-truce extension, Taiwan and an AI dialogue topping the agenda.

articles.headline: Summits can surprise. Will Trump and Xi make history?
articles.eng: Will the Trump-Xi summit make history?
articles.body: As Xi Jinping arrives in Washington, the question is whether the high-stakes summit can break the political and economic stalemate between the world's two largest economies.

articles.headline: Trump to address U.N., sign Greenland deal as annual session opens
articles.eng: Trump to sign Greenland deal at U.N.
articles.body: Trump is due to sign a new security arrangement with Denmark and Greenland, as well as meet leaders from Ukraine and Persian Gulf nations during the U.N. session.

articles.headline: White House media ban: Trump tells judge it's necessary to protect national security
articles.eng: Trump defends media ban in court
articles.body: The Trump administration told a judge that its ban of several news outlets from the White House was necessary to protect national security.

articles.headline: Another U.S. service member dies amid Iran war, Pentagon tally shows
articles.eng: Another US service member dies in Iran war
articles.body: The Pentagon's disclosed fatality total stands at 19, though officials say the actual number is higher, as the Iran conflict drags on.

articles.headline: Powerful nor'easter could bring a rough weekend to the Northeast
articles.eng: Nor'easter threatens Northeast weekend
articles.body: An unusually early September nor'easter could bring heavy rain and strong winds to the Northeast through the weekend.

articles.headline: Iran's economy cracks under U.S. pressure, but Tehran won't bend to Trump
articles.eng: Iran's economy cracks but Tehran won't bend
articles.body: As Iranians face shortages, Trump's naval blockade is eroding the country's economy more than sanctions, but Tehran remains uncowed.

articles.headline: Xi Jinping set to arrive for high-stakes summit with Donald Trump
articles.eng: Xi arrives for high-stakes summit with Trump
articles.body: Xi Jinping will land at Joint Base Andrews for his first Washington visit since 2015, with trade-truce extension (expiring Nov 10) and an AI dialogue on the agenda.

articles.headline: Will Trump and Xi extend their trade truce?
articles.eng: Will Trump and Xi extend their trade truce?
articles.body: After Trump's May visit to Beijing, Xi's reciprocal visit comes as the US-China trade truce nears expiry — with a 30bn tariff cut reportedly under discussion.

articles.headline: Chinese rare earth shipments to US drop ahead of Trump-Xi summit
articles.eng: Rare earth shipments to US drop
articles.body: Chinese rare earth shipments to the US have fallen ahead of the Trump-Xi summit, underscoring Beijing's leverage in the strategic materials standoff.

articles.headline: Bessent hails US-China AI dialogue ahead of Trump-Xi meeting
articles.eng: Bessent hails US-China AI dialogue
articles.body: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent hailed a new US-China AI dialogue, framing it as progress ahead of the Trump-Xi meeting in Washington.

articles.headline: What Xi wants from his summit with Trump
articles.eng: What Xi wants from the Trump summit
articles.body: Beijing aims to lock in a trade truce, discuss Taiwan and avoid escalation, while seeking affirmation of China's status as a co-equal power.

articles.headline: Has Trump caged his China hawks?
articles.eng: Has Trump caged his China hawks?
articles.body: Xi arrives in Washington to find a US president wary of jeopardising their détente, amid tension between Trump's dealmaking instincts and his hawkish advisers.
